Name: Fancy Fish and Tackles Retexture
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=4][font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc]Mainly retextures for [b]Tackles, Baits and crabpot [/b]and[b] beach forage[/b], but also some [b]fish[/b] (Stardew Valley Expanded fish included!).  Also works on android version of the game.[/color]

[u]Big thanks to the members of SDV discord modding channel for helping with coding![/u]

Highly configurable! You can pair it with mods like [b][url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10852]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] [/b]and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915]Better FIshing and Beach Forage[/url][/font][font=Georgia]

[/font][/size][font=Georgia][size=4]
[color=#ff7700]Credits:[/color]

[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Mainly inspired by Vanilla Tweaks and [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6915][/url]Better FIshing and Beach Forage mods;[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]At first I used some fish textures from Terraria but decided do remove it for now since I dunno for sure is it allowed to use it in non-terraria mods or not[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]Many inspiration  and references  while drawing are gained from Minecraft fishing expansion mods and random pics I found on Pinterest and Google.[/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4]in 1.0.1 version I used some fish sprites from [url=http://cyangmou.itch.io/pixel-rpg-icons-fishing-16x16]Pixel Art – Fishing & Diving Iconset  pack[/url][/size][size=1]﻿[/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia][size=1]
[u][font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc][size=2][center][/center][/size][/color][/font][/u]
